pose_constraints.posture: Strictly vertical 'Pillar' stance; standing stoutly on hind legs, head tilted slightly downward to present the dome prominently.
pose_constraints.orientation: Direct 0-degree head-on frontal view. The dome is the central, highest point.
pose_constraints.camera_angle: Low-angle 'Hero' shot, looking up to emphasize the thickness and mass of the dome-shaped skull.
pose_constraints.body_logic: Robust torso and short tail are completely occluded by the chest and thick neck. Silhouette width max 280px.
pose_constraints.framing_note: The entire dome and the surrounding bony knobs must be clearly visible and form a distinct, rounded silhouette.

character_details.expression: Determined and stoic; small, focused eyes looking forward.
character_details.texture: Thick, pebbly, leathery skin. Color: Earthy greens and browns on the body, with the dome a striking, smooth bone-white or pale grey, edged with vibrant red bony knobs.
features: Massive, domed skull surrounded by bony knobs and spikes.

environmental_details.ground: Damp, dark soil with scattered fallen leaves and woody debris, typical of the Hell Creek floodplains.
flora: Dense undergrowth of ferns and large-leafed flowering plants in the soft-focus background, suggesting a temperate forest.
environmental_details.sky: Overcast, humid Late Cretaceous sky with soft, diffused light, highlighting the dome's texture.
environmental_details.lighting: High-key 'Sunny Exposed Cinematic' lighting, with top-down light emphasizing the curvature and texture of the dome, creating soft, inviting highlights.
